summary: Daily meeting tokens could be minted by broad session participants, including assigned-but-unaccepted candidates, and for non-joinable statuses.
fix: Added accepted-session credential participant helper and joinable status gate.

summary: Deepgram grant 403 fallback returned the raw API key to the client.
fix: Removed client API-key fallback and fail closed with failed-precondition.

summary: VoIP tokens are stored on broadly readable user documents.
fix: New token registration now uses registerVoipToken callable and server-owned userPrivateTokens storage; rules block new public user-doc token writes; Functions use private-token helper with legacy fallback, scheduled/admin migration, and clear tombstone.

summary: Student Daily meeting token is stored in videoSessions and readable by participants.
fix: Stopped persisting student meeting tokens in videoSessions; student flow now fetches tokens through getSessionTokens.

summary: Client attempts to mark callConnectedAt/startedAt, but rules likely reject this server-owned state.
fix: Added authenticated markSessionConnected callable with accepted-participant and joinable-session checks; MinimalDailyWidget now calls the backend instead of writing server-owned timestamps.

summary: Precreated Daily rooms can be orphaned when final repeat/no-tutor guard blocks session creation.
fix: Delete precreated room on abandoned creation paths, including final repeat guard and no-tutor notification terminal path.

summary: Ended sessions do not delete Daily rooms, leaving room cleanup dependent on later jobs.
fix: Delete resolved Daily room during trusted end-session cleanup and await scheduled expiry deletion.

summary: Nullable videoDocRef is force-unwrapped in initState.
fix: Replaced the force unwrap with bindSession plus a safe missing-session state before subscribing or initializing the call widget.

summary: Cached session stream is not refreshed when videoDocRef changes, and session-scoped credential/navigation state can outlive the old reference.
fix: Added VideoCallPageModel.bindSession, call it from initState/didUpdateWidget, reset session-scoped Daily/Deepgram state, ignore stale credential callbacks, and guard terminal-status post-frame navigation after videoDocRef changes.

summary: Call control IconButtons lacked semantic labels/tooltips.
fix: Added state-aware tooltips/accessibility names for camera, microphone, chat, and end-call controls; added chat close/send tooltips, excluded duplicate unread badge semantics, and kept the chat send touch target at 48 dp.

summary: Dashboard permission gate can skip microphone request when camera is already granted.
fix: Added shared ensureCameraAndMicrophonePermissions helper that requests/rechecks both permissions independently; dashboard uses the helper in both start paths; waiting page, VoIP accept, and VideoCallPage gate backend/session/Daily start before media permissions are granted; VideoCallPage also rejects invalid session refs before prompting for media permissions.

summary: Expired active or connecting sessions could still mint fresh Daily and Deepgram credentials.
fix: Added expiresAt-based credential joinability gate shared by Daily and Deepgram callables.

summary: Daily and Deepgram credentials could outlive the remaining session window when minted near expiresAt.
fix: Capped credential TTL by remaining session time through shared getCredentialTtlSeconds helper.

summary: acceptCall idempotent paths could mint fresh Daily tokens for expired active sessions.
fix: Added joinable-session and remaining-TTL checks before returning Daily tokens from acceptCall.

summary: Daily replacement rooms could be created or persisted after a session ended, and acceptCall could orphan newly created rooms if cancel won the final race.
fix: Added fresh transactional joinability checks, final re-read before token minting, and transient room cleanup for failed accept/token replacement paths.

summary: Background FCM handler logged the full message data payload, which can include call metadata and future room/token fields.
fix: Replaced full payload logging with sanitized type/session-presence logging.

summary: Next-tutor assignment can be left unrecoverable if notification creation fails after currentTutorId is assigned.
fix: Added shared incoming-call notification helper; createVideoSession and declineCall now write the notification document in the same Firestore transaction as currentTutorId assignment, while processExpiredNotifications atomically expires the old notification, records the timed-out tutor, assigns the next tutor, and creates the next notification before best-effort push delivery.

summary: User documents remained readable by any signed-in user, and remaining self-updates included role/lifecycle state that should be allowlisted or callable-backed.
fix: VC-TR-012 restricts users reads to self/admin plus uid-constrained legacy lookup, blocks client writes to isInCall/currentSessionId/isAvailable/availableAfter/lastCallEndedAt, constrains role transitions to valid teacher-track-safe paths, removes client isInCall clearing from dashboard/profile writes, and adds Firestore Emulator coverage.

summary: Approved teachers could create withdrawal transactions for arbitrary amounts or with an unscoped card reference because transaction creation trusted client-authored finance data.
fix: Disabled client transaction creation, added requestWithdrawal callable that reads the current server balance, scopes cards to users/{uid}/cards/{cardId}, creates the withdrawal, and clears balance_NS transactionally.

summary: Student email/social registration could leave a new account without a role if the registration gift callable failed before role persistence.
fix: Persist student role before gift claiming and treat gift-claim failure as a non-blocking warning so the user can continue onboarding.

summary: VC-TR-005 inventory regeneration omitted current tranche Flutter files and AGENTS.md, making audit status incomplete despite a regenerated inventory.
fix: Updated the inventory script to include AGENTS.md, registration/social auth, pay_copy, and regenerated docs/project-audit-inventory.tsv; grouped open test gaps into an auditable counter list.

summary: Registration gift callable trusted mutable user role, allowing existing users to self-set role=student and claim registration gift minutes.
fix: Gated gift eligibility with trusted Firebase Auth account creation time and added helper tests that reject old accounts even if their user document says student.

summary: Legacy top-level isAvailable could override availabilityToday.enabled=false, letting a stale field make a tutor appear callable after the dashboard turned availability off.
fix: Made availabilityToday.enabled authoritative when present and kept top-level isAvailable only as a legacy fallback; added helper coverage for both paths.

summary: Client-only connected signals could promote a session to billing/chat/repeat-connected state without Daily-verified participant presence.
fix: Changed markSessionConnected to record advisory client signals only, added Daily presence/webhook two-party verification with current Daily presence before writing callConnectedAt/startedAt, and removed startedAt as connected proof for chat/repeat consumers.

summary: markSessionConnected accepted path-shaped or reserved session ids before reading videoSessions.doc(sessionId).
fix: Hardened sessionId normalization to reject path-shaped, empty, reserved, and oversized ids; added callable emulator coverage for invalid session ids and fail-closed two-client-signal behavior without a Daily room.

summary: Production smalltalk-2109b was missing required Firebase secrets, critical custom_cloud_functions exports, some deployed call lifecycle secret bindings, and acceptCall had Daily keys visible as plain environment metadata.
fix: Created/validated required Firebase secrets, deployed only readiness-gate target Functions, cleared stale plaintext Daily env vars from acceptCall metadata, and reran secret/deployment readiness gates to PASS.

summary: Legacy VoIP token batch migration could overwrite existing server-owned private FCM/PushKit tokens with stale public user document tokens.
fix: Preserve existing private tokens and tombstoned clears using transactional private-token and current legacy-field reads during migration while still deleting public legacy fields; added emulator/fake-db behavior coverage for VoIP migration and public-profile backfill.

summary: Secret readiness retry only covered spawn/timeout failures and could still fail on transient Firebase CLI JSON error payloads.
fix: Added retry handling for parsed Firebase JSON error payloads and regression coverage for command-error and JSON-error retry paths without printing secret values.

summary: New translateTerm callable was not included in both readiness surfaces: scoped deploy target and deployment readiness validator.
fix: Added functions:custom_cloud_functions:translateTerm to deploy:readiness-functions and REQUIRED_FUNCTIONS coverage so the feature callable is included in the controlled deploy path and readiness gate.

summary: Lowercasing the cache key could collide semantically different English terms such as May and may.
fix: Kept cache normalization whitespace-only/case-sensitive and added regression coverage that May and may produce different cache keys.

summary: Admin fallback reads could still expose server-owned translation cache documents containing raw source text.
fix: Added explicit translationCache/translationRateLimits server-owned rules and excluded those document paths from the admin fallback get path.

summary: Cache misses could call the Translation provider repeatedly without a per-user server-side limit.
fix: Added per-user daily provider-call limit and cooldown for cache misses; cache hits remain allowed without provider access.

summary: The catch-all admin fallback used read, so collection list queries could still enumerate translationCache and translationRateLimits despite document get exclusions.
fix: Changed the catch-all fallback to allow get only and added Firestore rules tests denying admin collection get for translationCache and translationRateLimits.

summary: Deployment readiness could pass while existing UI-used callables sendCustomEmailVerification and submitReview were absent or stale.
fix: Added both callables to REQUIRED_FUNCTIONS and the scoped deploy script; bound RESEND_API_KEY with runWith for sendCustomEmailVerification and added it to secret readiness.

summary: The freeze patch temporarily introduced unrelated protobufjs transitive lockfile churn after removing the paused Translation dependency.
fix: Restored the lockfile to remove unrelated protobufjs/@protobufjs version churn while keeping @google-cloud/translate absent.

summary: The freeze status row omitted docs/video-call-review-bugs.tsv while docs_updated_count still reported 8 updated docs.
fix: Added docs/video-call-review-bugs.tsv to the freeze status docs ledger and updated the bug counters.
